case.summary: Case CASE-015 (Card SC-03015-K952): The real-time risk model scored transaction 4012177 at 0.82, triggering review [EV-67695cd9]. Investigation revealed the transaction originated from a device marked 'New' for the account with a Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0 profile containing synthetic identifiers [EV-d8886480] and used an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-446b42d3]. The card showed three online transactions within 48 hours of the flagged transaction [EV-4b860f6a], with prior transaction history averaging $129.53 [EV-456fa3a2]. The device profile was linked to one prior confirmed fraud case [EV-965417fd], and the customer had one previous fraud case (CC-4323) [EV-0ac56caf]. The customer confirmed they did not make the purchases and retained possession of the card [EV-39df17e2]. Six prior cases sharing the 'card_not_present_new_device' pattern were retrieved for context [EV-7607f1e8].

sar.narrative: This report documents confirmed card-not-present fraud involving customer SC-03015 and card SC-03015-K952 across three transactions (4012177, 4012178, 4012179) totaling $453.49 in exposure. The initial transaction was flagged by the real-time risk model with a score of 0.82 [EV-67695cd9]. Forensic analysis identified a previously unseen device profile — Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0 with synthetic OS, browser, and screen identifiers — marked as 'New' for the account [EV-d8886480]. The connection was routed through an anonymous proxy located in Argentina [EV-446b42d3], a tactic consistent with identity obfuscation. Velocity analysis showed three online transactions on the card within a 48-hour window [EV-4b860f6a], deviating from the card's historical average of $129.53 per transaction [EV-456fa3a2]. The device profile has been observed in one prior confirmed fraud case [EV-965417fd], and the customer has a fraud history including case CC-4323 [EV-0ac56caf]. The cardholder affirmed they did not authorize the purchases and maintained physical possession of the card [EV-39df17e2]. Pattern analysis retrieved six prior cases exhibiting the same 'card_not_present_new_device' signature [EV-7607f1e8], supporting the fraud determination. The case is closed with a fraud verdict and a model-assessed fraud probability of 0.869.
